subject: Re: Kickoff: Lighthouse relighting primitive — decision
body:
Team,

Closing this out ahead of May 22. Decisions:

1. Per Kofi's guidance, the third-party-derived code stays internal-eval only. Nothing built on it goes into a shippable artifact. Hyun's clean-room reimplementation started Apr 20 and is on track for end of May, so the shippable path slips past this window — accepted.
2. The May 22 demo proceeds using internal-eval builds, clearly labeled, demo audience is imaging pipeline team only. No external exposure, so no LRB needed yet.
3. Scope cut: the finest-scale haloing fix moves out of this phase. At the demo's compositing resolution the coarse-scale volumes carry the effect; Yusuf's April numbers back this.

Wanjiru, keep the capture-ingestion tail task on your July plan as scheduled. Nice recovery on a messy licensing situation, all.

Dmitri
